description.narrative: The loan will partially finance the capital expenditure and expansion plans of Ocean Sparkle Limited (OSL), a leading port operations and management services provider in India, currently with an operational fleet of over 104 boats and presence in around 25 major and non-major ports in India with term-based, take-or-pay off-take contracts.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Average turnaround time at Indian ports where OSL operates reduces from 3.75 days in FY 2013 to 3.40 days in FY 2018
Total level of cargo handled in OSL-operated ports increases from approx. 621 million ton (MT) in FY 2013 to approx. 1,000 MT in FY2018
No pre- and post- berthing major accidents at the ports where OSL exclusively provides O&M services. Accidents include collision, fire and oil spill, among others
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47941/47941-001-esmr-en.pdf
